description:
`Scheduler::run` and `Scheduler::run_instrumented` in `crates/gf2-sim/src/executor/scheduler.rs` accept a `batch` argument and do not use it; the full sweep is taken from the pipeline's configuration.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The parameter is removed from both methods and every caller, or it selects the batch the methods process, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-02: Public Rustdoc of both methods states the resulting contract.
title: Scheduler::run and run_instrumented ignore their batch parameter
